about: The lines of v0.13 (main 16c01a1) that name a key, in Spanish, Polish and Russian, before lane s13-elev's E2-2 had them say the key as a key (la tecla, klawisz, клавишу): said by the local voices, the key's name ran into the verb or was lost. The control of the key rule of the words check (tools/listen-words.ts) and of the speech lint's key-word rule (tools/locale-lint.ts).
